# shell-expansion: values built from shell parameter expansion - substitutions, subscripts,
# lengths, error messages, nested defaults, offsets, command and arithmetic substitution and the
# special parameters. every name, pattern, replacement, default and literal piece reads as a word
# or a short number, an operand is written in uniform case, and a run of 20 or more bytes reads as
# words on its own, so an opaque operand, subscript or list item stays reported.
API_KEY=${API_KEY:-changeme}
token="${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}"
SECRET_KEY=${SECRET_KEY:-dev-secret-key-change-me}
client_secret="${CLIENT_SECRET:?client secret must be set}"
ACCESS_TOKEN=${ACCESS_TOKEN:-$(cat /run/secrets/access_token)}
display_path="${display_config/#$HOME/~}"
clean_name="${bundle_display_name//[$'\n\r\t']/}"
safe_name="${bundle_display_name//|/-}"
selection="${cleaned_selection//[[:space:]]/}"
for pattern in "${cleanup_protected_patterns[@]}"; do
pattern_count="${#cleanup_protected_patterns[*]}"
current_entry="${history_stack[$history_idx]}"
chosen_option="${menu_options[cursor]:--1}"
preferred_editor="${EDITOR:-${VISUAL:-vim}}"
stop_file="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/spinner_stop_$$_$session.flag"
diagnostic_log="${STATE_DIR:?missing}/diagnostic.log"
extracted_log="${archive_name:0:12}/extracted.log"
bundle_stem="${bundle_identifier%.appextension}"
snapshot_file="$((${#history_stack[@]}-1))/snapshot.json"
release_notes="$(basename)/release-notes.md"
# a named-key value made of expansions and punctuation alone is whatever the variables hold.
token="[${TASK_ID:0:8}]"
GITHUB_TOKEN="${TOKEN_PREFIX}-${RUN_ID:0:12}"
GITHUB_TOKEN=[${TASK_ID:0:8}]
api_key="${API_KEY_PREFIX}:${API_KEY_SUFFIX}"
client_secret="${CLIENT_SECRET:-${FALLBACK_CLIENT_SECRET}}"
# known gap: references alone whose words are all chunk-sized (`${raw_path/#\~/$HOME}`) carry no
# word a value cut into short groups could not, and stay reported.
# known gap: a camel-case word in an operand (`${bundle_id%.appExtension}`) is read like the mixed
# case of a random value there and stays reported.
# known gap: an expansion the capture cuts short - at a space inside `$(command arg)` or
# `${VAR:?a message}`, or before a closing `]}` or `)` the value grammar strips - is not read to its
# end and stays reported.
